description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of a varying parameter, likely related to consistency regularization strength, across four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis represents this parameter, ranging from 0.0 to 10.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, ranging from 18 to 28, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 2. The "Consistency-CE" method is shown as a light purple dashed line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 18.5 at x=0.0 and rising to about 24.5 at x=10.0. The "Inconsistency-CE" method is depicted as a dark purple solid line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of about 20.0 at x=0.0 and increasing to roughly 27.0 at x=10.0. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" method is represented by a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 18.5 at x=0.0 and reaching about 27.0 at x=10.0. The "Consistency-Bi" method is shown as a red solid line with star markers, beginning at a BLEU score of about 22.0 at x=0.0 and peaking at approximately 28.5 at x=7.5 before slightly declining to about 28.0 at x=10.0.
